## Why

F-409 / F-410 / F-416 (S0) + K7 NEW-1, K8 NEW-6, K14 §6.4: `/watch/` and
`/evidence/` told visitors their emptiness was a "research gap" and
offered the research queue as the remedy — but the gap is a *pipeline*
gap the queue cannot close (no producer, no bound document view), and a
research-queue CTA invites a visitor to "fix" something they cannot.
K14's five-part pattern replaces the vague label with the named cause.

## What this does

- **Cause-class empty states (K14 §6.4).** `web/src/lib/empty.ts`
  gains `EmptyStateParts` — state label, what is missing and why (the
  named cause), what exists nearby, what the visitor can do, when it
  may change — and the five cause-class surfaces (`watch`,
  `watchSubscriptions`, `recommender`, `citations`, `evidenceIndex`)
  carry it. `EmptyState.astro` renders the five parts with per-part
  `data-testid`s + `data-copy` batch ids. No "research gap" wording;
  no empty-state action routes to `/research-queue/`. Legacy
  `heading`/`body`/`cta` derive from the parts so the two render paths
  cannot drift.
- **Interim artifact list (K8 NEW-6).** `/evidence/` lists every
  artifact `evidence.json` carries — grouped by source (registry
  `source_name`, falling back to the id, never fabricated), each with
  a plain-language type label. A `capture_classification = 'synthetic'`
  artifact is labelled verbatim **"run record — SIG did not store this
  document"** (SIG-EVUI-D04) — never presented as a stored capture.
  Zero `<script>` on the page.
- **Exporter half.** `evidence_artifacts` in `EXPORT_QUERIES` now
  selects `source_name` (source_registry), `capture_classification`
  (latest evidence_capture row), and `upstream_url` — emitted ONLY
  where the effective-rights gate (`latest_decision`, P27.2/ADR-095)
  says `redistributable = 'yes'` (the S-6 scrub). The query applies
  the shared `{PUB_ARTIFACT_GATE}` — a withheld artifact never lists.
  `_evidence()` emits the three fields additively (absent = not
  known / not allowed, never fabricated).
- **Upstream links (K8 §5 item 5).** Where the gate emits
  `upstream_url`, the list shows it as **"the source's own link
  (recorded as a claim)"** — a claim, never a capture.
- **Static producer check (K7 NEW-1 / SIG-ENG-042).**
  `tests/unit/test_p34_20_producer_check.py` fails any web-surface
  builder read of a raw key no `EXPORT_QUERIES`/`shaping.QUERIES`/
  materialized seam produces, unless the key is declared in
  `DECLARED_UNPRODUCED_READ_KEYS` with its cause class (`contract_watch`
  → `no_producer` — the honest "not connected yet" state). It reports
  the evaluated count and carries a planted-key negative control.
- **No fixture capture diff in export builds (SIG-EVUI-D05).**
  `getCaptureDiff()` returns `null` under `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export`;
  the composed export build sweeps the whole `dist` for the fixture
  capture ids and claim-view routes and asserts none.
- **Copy batch.** 27 new public sentences appended to
  `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-02.md` (`EW-01`…`EW-27`,
  sha256-pinned, `pending` — the B-2 rule: only N-strings ship until
  confirmed at P34.21b). `ops/publish.py#check_publishable_copy` now
  scans **every** committed `batch-*.md`, so a pending batch-02 row
  refuses `--apply` instead of misreporting `untracked`.
- **P34.18 leftover repaired fix-forward (recorded):** the
  `source_aliases.py` docstring still carried the retired personal
  token; on machines holding the gitignored restricted map the rekey
  idempotency test failed. The docstring now uses the sweep's own
  neutral form — a tracked-file `git grep` for the retired token is 0
  hits (the plaintext lives only in the gitignored restricted map).
